verses.76:11: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمۡ نَضۡرَةࣰ وَسُرُورࣰ ا

en_note: Manually curated in Phase 3 from Quran-attested forms, corrected selected glosses, and classical lexicon evidence.
meaning: The root نَضَرَ (naḍara) denotes beauty, freshness and purity of colour. Ibn Fāris gives its core as حسن وجمال وخلوص; نَضْرَة is the radiance of a face, and the root also yields نُضار, pure gold.
meaning_source: Derived from the classical dictionaries (chiefly Maqayis al-Lugha, Ibn Faris d.1004) held in lexicon_full/
